config.hypothesis: A calibrated quaternion center per removed channel may improve output reconstruction and recovery beyond output-refitted shared A alone, without changing deployed Q architecture.
config.method: ONE late consumer, CIFAR BN2026 f=.5. Reuse direct-pilot sites0-3. Fit pre-BN current-reference output on existing cached moments for500 fit images; separate500 check, validation1000. U=U0+(A-A0)C-A*mu; A0 is old nonzero feature-ridge maps, U0 is exactly the old rounded fold. This anchors B=U0-A0*C to eliminate initialization-rounding differences. mu[v] is ONE Q per removed input, shared across all32 outputs/all9 offsets. B,C,other layers/BN/head are fixed during label-free calibration. Joint linear fit over deltaA,d is accepted only if a subsequent Q linear solve recovers mu with A*mu=d to tolerance; otherwise report failure and stop, without claiming a bilinear solution. No iterative SGD/local-stationary/global-novelty claim. Common objective SSE+lambda||U-U0||^2; lambda reused from the original direct output fit, NOT coefficient-decay ridge. Same support/masks. Final real-head maps recomputed identically per arm; then four matched supervised3ep repairs train all ordinary parameters. Reused direct-Q reference contextual, not a new repair. No sweep/new baseline/new test/automatic replication.
config.counts: Calibration variables A1024, mu64, joint1088; full Q local consumer18432 coefficients before final output pruning. Joint linear-space d has64reals and recovered mu64, not both retained as separate model variables. Final six Q convolutions/19098 reals; temporary A,mu,C discarded. Labeled repair always19098 trainables.
config.resume: Cached calibration solutions saved once; per-case atomic completed-epoch CE model/optimizer/scaler/scheduler/RNG checkpoint. STOP requests pause after batch; remove only explicitly resuming. A partial epoch is repeated. No best checkpoint selection.
